title: Check Lane Activity for missing dimension data (Scandata/Induct/SortConf) and identify AI01 not sending data
summary: Use the Lane Activity view/record that captures Scandata, Induct, and SortConf to determine whether missing dimension data is occurring. If AI01 is not sending any data, the system uses default dimensions, which the source ties to overfilling.
when_to_use: Use when you suspect missing dimension data is contributing to default dimensions being applied (e.g., symptoms consistent with overfilling) and you need to confirm whether AI01 is not sending data by checking Lane Activity evidence for Scandata, Induct, and SortConf.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to confirm the root cause beyond the AI01 no-data condition; if Lane Activity shows dimension data present for AI01, escalate to broader troubleshooting.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open and review the Lane Activity view/record that captures Scandata, Induct, and SortConf; verify whether AI01 is sending dimension-related data and document the observed missing-data condition.
access_or_tools_needed: Lane Activity view/record that captures Scandata, Induct, and SortConf
Ability to view AI01-related Lane Activity records

steps.title: Open the Lane Activity view/record that records Scandata, Induct, and SortConf
steps.purpose: Provide the evidence source where Scandata, Induct, and SortConf messages are tracked so you can assess whether dimension data is missing.
steps.instruction: Open the Lane Activity view/record referenced by the source that records Scandata, Induct, and SortConf, and navigate to the area where AI01-related entries would be visible.
steps.expected_result: Lane Activity evidence is visible showing the sections/fields for Scandata, Induct, and SortConf for the relevant lane/work area.
steps.healthy_condition: Lane Activity shows entries with Scandata, Induct, and SortConf message evidence for the period you are investigating.
steps.failure_condition: Lane Activity does not show the expected Scandata/Induct/SortConf evidence for the period being reviewed (or the view cannot be accessed).

actions.label: Open Lane Activity record/view
actions.exact_action: Open the Lane Activity view/record described in the source (the one that records Scandata, Induct, and SortConf).

source_evidence.quote: “checked the Lane Activity which records Scandata, Indcut, And SortConf.”

steps.title: Locate dimension-data entries and confirm whether dimension data is missing
steps.purpose: Determine whether the Lane Activity evidence indicates missing dimension data conditions.
steps.instruction: In the Lane Activity view/record, locate the entries related to dimension data and confirm whether dimension data is missing (i.e., the evidence indicates missing dimension data for the relevant items/messages).
steps.expected_result: Lane Activity evidence indicates missing dimension data for the items/messages under investigation.
steps.healthy_condition: Lane Activity evidence shows dimension-related data present (not missing) for the relevant entries.
steps.failure_condition: Lane Activity evidence shows missing dimension data for the relevant entries.

actions.label: Confirm missing dimension data
actions.exact_action: Locate the entries related to dimension data and confirm whether dimension data is missing.

source_evidence.quote: “We track if we are missing dimension data…”

steps.title: Check whether AI01 is “not sending any data”
steps.purpose: Identify the specific source of the missing dimension data by verifying whether AI01 is not sending any data.
steps.instruction: Within the Lane Activity evidence, check the AI01-related entries and verify whether AI01 is “not sending any data” (i.e., there is no data being sent in the Lane Activity evidence for AI01).
steps.expected_result: AI01-related Lane Activity evidence shows a no-data condition consistent with “AI01 was not sending any data.”
steps.healthy_condition: AI01-related Lane Activity evidence shows data being sent (not a no-data condition).
steps.failure_condition: AI01-related Lane Activity evidence shows no data being sent.

actions.label: Verify AI01 no-data condition
actions.exact_action: Check whether AI01 is “not sending any data.”

source_evidence.quote: “noticed Al01 was not sending any data.”

steps.title: If AI01 is not sending data, confirm default dimensions are being used and tie to overfilling
steps.purpose: Validate the operational impact described by the source: missing dimension data leads to default dimensions, which the source ties to overfilling.
steps.instruction: If the Lane Activity evidence confirms AI01 is not sending any data, interpret the impact as the system using default dimensions (default dims) and note that the source associates this with overfilling.
steps.expected_result: Your findings support the chain: AI01 no-data condition → missing dimension data → system uses default dimensions (default dims) → overfilling risk/occurrence as described by the source.
steps.healthy_condition: AI01 is sending data and missing-dimension/default-dimension behavior is not indicated by the Lane Activity evidence.
steps.failure_condition: AI01 no-data condition is present and missing dimension data is indicated, consistent with default dimensions being applied.

actions.label: Apply source-described impact
actions.exact_action: If AI01 is not sending data, note that the system uses “default dims,” which the source ties to “overfilling.”

source_evidence.quote: “Causing us to use default dims. ie. overfilling”
“The item default dimension model stores the default dimensions when one is missing.”

success_criteria: Lane Activity evidence shows missing dimension data conditions.
AI01-related Lane Activity evidence indicates AI01 is not sending any data.
Findings align with the source-described impact: default dimensions are used and this is associated with overfilling.
healthy_conditions: Lane Activity shows dimension data present (not missing) for AI01-related entries.
AI01-related Lane Activity evidence indicates data is being sent.
failure_conditions: Lane Activity indicates missing dimension data.
AI01-related Lane Activity evidence indicates AI01 is not sending any data.
If AI01 has dimension data present, do not conclude default-dims/overfilling cause from this procedure.
escalation_guidance: If Lane Activity shows dimension data present for AI01, do not assume the default-dims/overfilling cause from this source; escalate to broader troubleshooting.
